title: Fire Safety Blackouts
description: Why fire risk rises in outages and how to prevent it: battery lights instead of candles, safe heating, cooking, and generator use, and working smoke and CO alarms. Covers escape planning, what to do if trapped, and when and how to use a fire extinguisher.
shortDescription: Flashlights over candles, smoke alarms, outage heating and cooking, escape plans
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
